# EconStor

> > EconStor is an open access repository for economic literature operated by ZBW, providing searchable access to research papers, working papers, and journal articles.

EconStor serves as a central platform for discovering and accessing economic research, featuring integration with EconBiz search, comprehensive journal listings, and document browsing capabilities. The site implements Anubis bot protection using Hashcash proof-of-work challenges to prevent automated scraping while maintaining accessibility for legitimate users.

## Key Topics

- Open Access Economics Research
- EconBiz Search Integration
- ZBW (German National Library of Economics)
- Working Papers and Journal Articles
- Repository Handles (10419/*)
- Anubis Bot Protection
- Hashcash Proof-of-Work
- Anti-Scraping Technology
- COAR (Confederation of Open Access Repositories)
- Document Type Classification
- Economic Literature Archive
- JavaScript-Based Security Challenges
- Academic Repository Management

## Core Features

- [EconStor Homepage](https://www.econstor.eu/): Main entry point to EconStor's open access repository of economic literature
- [About EconStor](https://www.econstor.eu/about): Information about the repository, its mission, and services
- [Open Access Resources](https://www.econstor.eu/openaccess): Overview of open access policies and freely available research materials

## Search and Discovery

- [EconBiz Search](https://www.econstor.eu/econbiz-search): Integrated search interface for discovering economic research across EconBiz and EconStor
- [Browse by Document Type](https://www.econstor.eu/browse?type=doctype): Navigate repository content organized by document categories (working papers, articles, etc.)
- [Journal List](https://www.econstor.eu/journal-list): Comprehensive directory of journals archived in EconStor

## Repository Access

- [Repository Handle System](https://www.econstor.eu/handle/10419/6): Persistent identifier system for accessing specific documents and collections

## Community and Updates

- [EconStor Blog](https://blog.econstor.eu/): ZBW blog featuring updates on open access, repository developments, and economic research trends

## Optional

- [German Language Version](https://www.econstor.eu/.;?&locale=de): German localized interface for EconStor
